concerns: In TGAccountRepository and LeadRepository, the atomic status update queries use @Modifying(clearAutomatically = true) but are missing flushAutomatically = true, which can lead to Hibernate first-level cache serving stale entity states.

The PR modifies existing Flyway migration files directly rather than creating a new migration using the designated timestamp V20260726003403610, which can lead to migration checksum validation failures.
The application.properties disables Flyway validation ('spring.flyway.validate-on-migrate=false') which can mask schema mismatches.

SpintaxService instantiates a default Random instance per-request or uses a standard Random instance under concurrency which can lead to performance bottlenecks and poor distribution compared to ThreadLocalRandom or SecureRandom.
